title: What to do tomorrow?
simplified_paragraphs: B：是呢，我忘了。明天上午我想在家睡觉，下午我想去书店买书，你呢？
A：我想买一个杯子，一盒牛奶，还有一些水果。
B：我家也没有水果了。现在的苹果很好，你帮我也买一斤吧。
A：没问题。我明天几点给你苹果？
B：明天我五点从书店回家，你五点来我家吧。你也可以在我家吃饭，明天我们自己做，怎么样？
traditional_paragraphs: B：是呢，我忘了。明天上午我想在家睡覺，下午我想去書店買書，你呢？
A：我想買一個杯子，一盒牛奶，還有一些水果。
B：我家也沒有水果了。現在的蘋果很好，你幫我也買一斤吧。
A：沒問題。我明天幾點給你蘋果？
B：明天我五點從書店回家，你五點來我家吧。你也可以在我家吃飯，明天我們自己做，怎麼樣？
pinyin_paragraphs: A： míng tiān nǐ xiǎng zuò shén me？
B： míng tiān qù xué xiào。
A： míng tiān Xīng qī liù， xiū xi。
B： shì ne， wǒ wàng le。 míng tiān shàng wǔ wǒ xiǎng zài jiā shuì jiào， xià wǔ wǒ xiǎng qù shū diàn mǎi shū， nǐ ne？
A： wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi dōng xi。
B： nǐ xiǎng mǎi shén me？
A： wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī gè bēi zi， yī hé niú nǎi， hái yǒu yī xiē shuǐ guǒ。
B： nǐ xǐ huan chī shén me shuǐ guǒ？
A： wǒ xǐ huan chī xiāng jiāo hé píng guǒ。
B： wǒ jiā yě méi yǒu shuǐ guǒ le。 xiàn zài de píng guǒ hěn hǎo， nǐ bāng wǒ yě mǎi yī jīn ba。
A： méi wèn tí。 wǒ míng tiān jǐ diǎn gěi nǐ píng guǒ？
B： míng tiān wǒ wǔ diǎn cóng shū diàn huí jiā， nǐ wǔ diǎn lái wǒ jiā ba。 nǐ yě kě yǐ zài wǒ jiā chī fàn， míng tiān wǒ men zì jǐ zuò， zěn me yàng？
A： hǎo， míng tiān wǔ diǎn wǒ qù nǐ jiā。
english_paragraphs: A: What do you want to do tomorrow?
B: Yes, I forgot. I want to sleep at home tomorrow morning, and I want to go to the bookstore to buy books in the afternoon. What about you?
A: I want to go shopping.
B: What do you want to buy?
A: I want to buy a cup, a carton of milk, and some fruit.
B: What fruit do you like to eat?
A: I like to eat bananas and apples.
B: There is no more fruit at my house. The apples are very good now. Please help me buy a pound.
A: No problem. What time should I give you the apple tomorrow?
B: I will go home from the bookstore at five o'clock tomorrow. You can come to my house at five o'clock. You can also have dinner at my house and we can cook it ourselves tomorrow, how about that?
A: OK, I will go to your house at five o'clock tomorrow.

B: Go to school tomorrow.

B: I will go home from the bookstore at five o'clock tomorrow. You can come to my house at five o'clock. You can also have dinner at my house and we can cook it ourselves tomorrow, how about that?
